desc: Fix the small-branch query tuple construction and validate both public samples.
Optimize the large-dimension block branch; the current block size 320 can require infeasible \(O(QB^2)\) rectangle recomputation.
Brute-force compare the corrected algorithm against random small grids, including zero values, repeated updates, source/destination updates, and boundary-touching cases.
Verify block-branch boundary extraction and correctness on balanced-dimension cases.
Produce the final optimized Python solution and verify input/output behavior.
